purpose: Research-only retrieval benchmark evidence; not approval for clinical release or individual-risk claims
source_representation: Local PDFs were reviewed; only PubMed metadata and abstracts are indexed because full-text storage/display licenses were not established for the whole set.
review_method: Design-matched domain review of the supplied full texts: selection and measurement, confounding/temporality, analysis, applicability, and claim support for empirical work; citation traceability, balanced interpretation, and scope for narrative or methodological work. PROBAST domains inform the prediction-model paper. Judgments are bounded-use, not additive checklist scores.

human_approval.basis: Project conversation: all supplied papers with PMID, within 20 years, and in scope were approved for addition to the same Qdrant database

pubmed_metadata_check.provider: NCBI PubMed EFetch XML over verified HTTPS
pubmed_metadata_check.result: All 14 PMIDs and DOIs resolved; no retraction or correction flag observed. PMIDs 39755698 and 41565822 have UpdateOf links to earlier records, which are not retraction/correction flags.

score_mapping: The existing Silpa-approved binary rule assigns 1.0 to a source admitted for its bounded research use; this is not a comparative or additive quality estimate.

appraisals.bounded_use: Explain preclinical evidence about parental preconception drug exposure and possible transgenerational mechanisms only.
appraisals.strength: The review distinguishes preconception from direct prenatal exposure and cites drug-class-specific experiments.
appraisals.critical_limit: Evidence is predominantly animal/preclinical and narratively selected; do not infer human offspring psychiatric risk or clinical advice.

appraisals.bounded_use: Explain confounder-by-exposure and confounder-by-genotype adjustment issues in gene-by-environment interaction studies.
appraisals.strength: Analytic argument and worked examples directly support the statistical caution.
appraisals.critical_limit: It is a methodological critique, not a pooled effect estimate or evidence that any specific GxE association is true or false.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe associations of schizophrenia PRS, parental socioeconomic status and family history in the Danish sampled setting.
appraisals.strength: Incident register-defined cases and independently derived PRS are analyzed with explicit limitations.
appraisals.critical_limit: 866 cases and 871 controls, diagnostic and ancestry transportability limits, crude childhood SES, and residual confounding prevent individual prediction or causal interpretation. PubMed's Meta-Analysis tag reflects the PRS derivation, not this paper's primary design.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe the proposed cognition-reward circuit synthesis in schizophrenia as a hypothesis.
appraisals.strength: Integrates cited animal physiology and human clinical observations while presenting a coherent model.
appraisals.critical_limit: Focused, non-systematic evidence selection and translational inference do not establish the proposed circuit model as a validated cause or treatment target.

appraisals.bounded_use: Report limitations of predicting general adolescent mental-health symptoms from the Swedish twin data; cite the authors' statement that the model is not suitable for clinical use.
appraisals.strength: Large twin sample, comparator algorithms, and reported discrimination with uncertainty.
appraisals.critical_limit: Broad parent-rated outcome, twin and setting applicability concerns, no demonstrated clinical utility, and model performance insufficient for clinical use; no model export or individual prediction is authorized.

appraisals.bounded_use: Explain what a PRS is and why it cannot definitively predict an individual psychiatric diagnosis.
appraisals.strength: Explicitly addresses limited predictive accuracy and clinical-utility caveats.
appraisals.critical_limit: A selective primer, not a disorder-specific effect synthesis or validation of this project's model or PRS inputs.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe investigated environmental associations and GxE uncertainty for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, distinguishing stronger schizophrenia from weaker bipolar evidence.
appraisals.strength: Cites exposure classes and explicitly identifies underpowered candidate-gene GxE studies and gaps.
appraisals.critical_limit: Not a systematic review; exposure-specific claims require primary-study confirmation and no causal or individual-risk conclusion follows from the narrative.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe the observed association between diagnosed cannabis use disorder and diagnosed schizophrenia in Danish registers by age and sex.
appraisals.strength: Nationwide longitudinal registers with nearly six million people and measured covariate adjustment.
appraisals.critical_limit: Only diagnosed cases are captured, cannabis dose and THC content are unavailable, and residual/reverse-direction confounding remains. Attributable fractions are not causal proof.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe associations between retrospectively reported childhood adversity and later register-defined adult psychiatric diagnoses in Swedish twins.
appraisals.strength: Large nationwide twin sample, independent register outcomes, and within-pair analyses address some shared familial confounding.
appraisals.critical_limit: Retrospective ACE recall, nonshared confounding, and cultural/setting applicability remain; not an individual-risk estimate or causal proof.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe cross-sectional associations of adolescent psychedelic use with self-reported psychotic or manic symptoms in the sampled twins.
appraisals.strength: Twin design and explicit sensitivity analyses explore some shared factors.
appraisals.critical_limit: Most exposed participants also used other drugs, dose/context are unknown, symptoms are self-reported, and temporal direction is unresolved; no causal safety claim.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe associations among recalled emotional abuse, aberrant-salience scale scores and positive symptoms in the studied schizophrenia-spectrum patients.
appraisals.strength: Defined clinical sample, named scales and reported indirect-path estimates.
appraisals.critical_limit: 222 treated participants, self-reported exposure/mediator, treatment confounding, and cross-sectional design mean mediation cannot be read causally.

appraisals.bounded_use: Explain exploratory links between psychiatric GWAS signals, adult brain cell types/regions and functional connectivity.
appraisals.strength: Triangulates genomic, single-cell atlas and independent imaging datasets.
appraisals.critical_limit: Brain regions and donors are unevenly represented, adult atlas misses developmental variation, and cell/region enrichment is not patient-level risk or a validated mechanism.

appraisals.bounded_use: Summarize genomic architecture and current clinical-utility limitations for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and major depression.
appraisals.strength: Explicit disease scope and broad citation of large GWAS, sequencing and functional-genomics findings.
appraisals.critical_limit: Non-systematic review; genomic association and proposed biology cannot be converted into a diagnosis, an individual PRS estimate, or treatment recommendation.

appraisals.bounded_use: Describe schizophrenia association discoveries and ancestry-transfer limits in the studied genomic cohorts.
appraisals.strength: African-ancestry case-control data, cross-ancestry comparison, fine-mapping and transcriptomic follow-up.
appraisals.critical_limit: Veteran/EHR and other cohort ascertainment, ancestry composition and association-to-mechanism inference limit generalization; no individualized risk prediction.

release_gate: Human item-by-item quality adjudication, question-level bounded-use enforcement, and retrieval validation remain necessary before clinical-facing use.
